tool.title: Resolve a review thread on a merge request (GitLab)
tool.description: Mark one discussion on a merge request as resolved.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: Absent: the merge request of the current branch.

inputs.name: thread
inputs.description: The discussion id, or a prefix of 8 or more of it.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitLab API another way. A self-managed GitLab answers on its own host, which this record cannot name; `glab` reaches it once `glab auth login --hostname` has been run for that host.
